publication.title: Interactive Visual Exploration of Knowledge Graphs with Embedding-based Guidance

implementation_engines.name: TransR/RotatE/AttH/UMAP
implementation_engines.role: precomputed relation embeddings, peculiarity and projection

descriptions.interaction: Keyword search, schema relation selection, group brushing, linked views, filtering, graph expansion and saving summary subgraphs.
descriptions.guidance: Embedding-derived peculiarity, similarity context and ranked relation recommendations. TransR,RotatE,AttH models feed peculiarity; UMAP displays relation embeddings.
descriptions.visualisation: Schema, embedding scatterplots, force-directed KG views and multi-relation summary panel; group colour and degree-encoded labels.
descriptions.backend: Multi-relational triples with precomputed KG embeddings; no live SPARQL/Cypher endpoint or implementation stack specified in main report.

report_level_evaluation.tasks: task: Open-ended exploration; duration minutes: 15; task: Focused sibling-group exploration; duration minutes: 10
report_level_evaluation.comparators: Simplified KGScope removing embedding,relation recommendation andbrush-group panels; search/relation entries randomly ordered. Baseline still supported force-directed node expansion and summarization.
report_level_evaluation.measures: Six5point usability questions; Coded insights; Group-related findings; Qualitative interviews
report_level_evaluation.results: reported questionnaire: KGScope higher ratings with reported p<0.05 for Q2–Q6, not Q1(open-ended exploration).; unknown entity insights: baseline: 3; kgscope: 15; unexpected findings: baseline: 9; kgscope: 17; participants reporting groups task1: baseline: 3; kgscope: 10; denominator: 12; limits: Small postgraduate sample; bundled visual/guidance intervention rather than isolated embedding ablation; statistical test/multiplicity procedure not named in main paper; no population-wide usability inference.
report_level_evaluation.limitations: Small postgraduate sample; bundled visual/guidance intervention rather than isolated embedding ablation; statistical test/multiplicity procedure not named in main paper; no population-wide usability inference.
